text: Hòa Phát Group plans to establish $24.6 million renewable energy company
HÀ NỘI - Industrial manufacturing group Hòa Phát (HPG) has approved a plan to establish a new entity in the energy sector, with a projected charter capital of VNĐ650 billion (US$25 million).

According to a recent resolution of the company's Board of Directors, the new company - named Hòa Phát Renewable Energy Joint Stock Company - will focus on the investment, production and trading of electricity, with an emphasis on renewable energy sources.
HPG intends to hold a 99.98 per cent stake in the new company, effectively accounting for nearly the entire charter capital.
The headquarters of the new company will be located at 66 Nguyễn Du Street, Cửa Nam Ward, Hà Nội City - the same address as the parent group's headquarters.
The Board of Directors has also authorised Deputy General Director Trần Thị Thu Hiền to manage the group's entire equity stake in the new entity.
According to its consolidated financial statements for the third quarter of 2026, as of September 30 this year, HPG reported having four subsidiaries and two associates.
This marked another move by HPG in the energy sector.
In June, the group worked with individuals and other enterprises to establish the Sông Hậu Offshore Wind Power Joint Stock Company, which has a charter capital of VNĐ2 trillion.

In addition to these new investment initiatives, HPG currently generates electricity by capturing waste heat and excess gases produced during manufacturing processes at its integrated steel complexes.

HPG said that in the first 10 months of 2026, over 4.6 billion kWh of electricity was produced at the power generation plants, which use waste heat and excess gases at the Hòa Phát Dung Quất and Hòa Phát Hải Dương integrated steel complexes.
This output met more than 90 per cent of the electricity demand required for production at these two complexes.
Based on current electricity prices, this self-generated power represents a value equivalent to VNĐ8.8 trillion.

In the first nine months of 2026, HPG recorded a revenue of around VNĐ171.5 trillion and a profit after tax of VNĐ23.8 trillion, an increase of 54 per cent and 104 per cent, respectively, compared to the same period in 2025.
For the year, the group has set targets of VNĐ210 trillion in revenue and VNĐ22 trillion in profit after tax. - BIZHUB/VNS
